description: This file contains utility functions for calculating various values (time-based, contribution, average) used in a visualization component, specifically for a TimeTable visualization in Apache Superset.

methods.name: calculateTimeValue
methods.description: Calculates time-based values with lag and comparison types

methods.name: calculateAverage
methods.description: Calculates average value over a time period

methods.name: calculateCellValue
methods.description: Calculates cell values based on column type
